owasp_top10_2021.name: Broken Access Control
owasp_top10_2021.description: Restrictions on what authenticated users are allowed to do are often not properly enforced

threats.title: Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR)
threats.description: Users can access resources by manipulating IDs without authorization checks
threats.mitigation: Implement proper authorization checks, use indirect references, validate user permissions

threats.title: Missing Function Level Access Control
threats.description: API endpoints or functions accessible without proper role verification
threats.mitigation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC), verify permissions on every request

threats.title: Privilege Escalation
threats.description: Users can elevate their privileges beyond intended permissions
threats.mitigation: Principle of least privilege, regular permission audits, secure session management

owasp_top10_2021.name: Cryptographic Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Failures related to cryptography which often lead to exposure of sensitive data

threats.title: Weak Encryption Algorithms
threats.description: Use of outdated or weak encryption (MD5, SHA1, DES)
threats.mitigation: Use AES-256, SHA-256 or stronger, TLS 1.3, modern key management

threats.title: Hardcoded Secrets
threats.description: API keys, passwords, or certificates hardcoded in source code
threats.mitigation: Use secret management systems (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), environment variables

threats.title: Insufficient Transport Layer Protection
threats.description: Sensitive data transmitted without encryption or with weak TLS
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS everywhere, use HSTS, disable weak ciphers

owasp_top10_2021.name: Injection
owasp_top10_2021.description: User-supplied data is not validated, filtered, or sanitized by the application

threats.title: SQL Injection
threats.description: Malicious SQL queries executed through unsanitized inputs
threats.mitigation: Parameterized queries, ORM, input validation, least privilege DB accounts

threats.title: NoSQL Injection
threats.description: Injection attacks against NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra)
threats.mitigation: Input validation, use database-specific sanitization, parameterized queries

threats.title: Command Injection
threats.description: OS commands executed through unsanitized user input
threats.mitigation: Avoid system calls, use safe APIs, input validation, sandboxing

threats.title: LDAP Injection
threats.description: LDAP queries manipulated through user input
threats.mitigation: Input validation, escape special characters, use safe LDAP APIs

threats.title: Missing Rate Limiting
threats.description: No protection against brute force or resource exhaustion attacks
threats.mitigation: Implement rate limiting, CAPTCHA, account lockout policies

threats.title: Insecure Password Recovery
threats.description: Password reset mechanism vulnerable to account takeover
threats.mitigation: Multi-factor verification, secure tokens, time-limited reset links

threats.title: Business Logic Flaws
threats.description: Application logic can be abused to bypass security controls
threats.mitigation: Threat modeling, security reviews, abuse case testing

owasp_top10_2021.name: Security Misconfiguration
owasp_top10_2021.description: Missing appropriate security hardening or improperly configured permissions

threats.title: Default Credentials
threats.description: Systems deployed with default usernames and passwords
threats.mitigation: Force password change on first login, disable default accounts

threats.title: Unnecessary Features Enabled
threats.description: Unused services, ports, or features left enabled
threats.mitigation: Disable unused features, minimal installation, regular audits

threats.title: Verbose Error Messages
threats.description: Error messages expose sensitive system information
threats.mitigation: Generic error messages, detailed logs server-side only

threats.title: Missing Security Headers
threats.description: HTTP security headers not configured (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options)
threats.mitigation: Configure all security headers, use security.txt

threats.title: Unpatched Dependencies
threats.description: Third-party libraries with known CVEs not updated
threats.mitigation: Dependency scanning (Snyk, Dependabot), regular updates, SCA tools

threats.title: End-of-Life Software
threats.description: Using software that no longer receives security updates
threats.mitigation: Maintain inventory, plan migrations, monitor EOL dates

owasp_top10_2021.name: Identification and Authentication Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Confirmation of the user's identity, authentication, and session management is critical

threats.title: Weak Password Policy
threats.description: Allows weak passwords, no complexity requirements
threats.mitigation: Enforce strong passwords, password strength meter, breach detection

threats.title: Credential Stuffing
threats.description: Automated injection of breached username/password pairs
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting, CAPTCHA, breach password detection, MFA

threats.title: Session Fixation
threats.description: Attacker sets user's session ID before authentication
threats.mitigation: Regenerate session ID after login, secure session management

owasp_top10_2021.name: Software and Data Integrity Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Code and infrastructure that does not protect against integrity violations

threats.title: Insecure Deserialization
threats.description: Untrusted data deserialized leading to RCE
threats.mitigation: Avoid deserialization of untrusted data, integrity checks, type validation

threats.title: Supply Chain Attack
threats.description: Compromised dependencies or build pipeline
threats.mitigation: Verify package signatures, use private registries, SBOM

threats.title: Unsigned Code/Updates
threats.description: Software updates not cryptographically signed
threats.mitigation: Code signing, secure update mechanism, checksum verification

owasp_top10_2021.name: Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
owasp_top10_2021.description: Without logging and monitoring, breaches cannot be detected

threats.title: Insufficient Logging
threats.description: Critical events not logged or logs incomplete
threats.mitigation: Log all security events, centralized logging, log retention policy

threats.title: No Alerting on Suspicious Activity
threats.description: Anomalies not detected or alerted
threats.mitigation: SIEM, automated alerting, anomaly detection, SOC

threats.title: Log Injection
threats.description: Attackers inject malicious data into logs
threats.mitigation: Sanitize log inputs, structured logging, log integrity

owasp_top10_2021.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
owasp_top10_2021.description: Application fetches remote resources without validating user-supplied URL

threats.title: Internal Network Scanning
threats.description: Attacker uses SSRF to scan internal network
threats.mitigation: URL whitelist, disable unnecessary protocols, network segmentation

threats.title: Cloud Metadata Access
threats.description: SSRF used to access cloud instance metadata (AWS, Azure, GCP)
threats.mitigation: IMDSv2, network policies, URL validation, disable metadata endpoint
